item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The coalition-government reform entered into force on 31 December 2022 and allowed people with tolerated status who had been in Germany for five years on 1 October 2022 to apply for an 18-month residence permit without initially fulfilling usual legalisation criteria; since its entry into force, at least 49,000 people applied, around 17,000 applications were granted, and 2,100 refused.","notes":["The excerpt does not describe the permit as permanent; it describes an 18-month residence permit followed by requirements to secure legal stay."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E010","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"As of December 2023, BAMF had 8,447 positions, including 7,355 full-time positions in various asylum departments, and maintained quality-management, operational-management, and special-security functions. BAMF used second-employee checks, random quality controls, and monitoring of branch offices with unusually divergent protection rates.","notes":["The excerpt does not support the claim that monitoring results were not automatically public."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E011","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The exact excerpt concerns BAMF staffing and quality controls; it does not contain the proposed 6.8-month average, 239,614 pending cases, or 3.1-month Dublin average."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E016","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E017","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E018","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E019","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R01-E020","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
